name: Image Analysis
description: Look at an image and describe it, or answer a question about it.
abilities: Describes a photo, chart, diagram or screenshot
Answers a specific question about what an image shows
Works on images you attach, images in your workspace and public image links
permissions: Sends the image, and your question, to the vision model

changes.notes: Now a plugin in the Store, separate from Image Generation. Turn it off here when you don't want it.
